derived.recovery_strategy: Recomputed asynchronously from Document and DocumentChunk records post-restore

document_storage.storage_engine: Encrypted Local Volume / S3-compatible Object Storage
document_storage.backup_strategy: Replicated object storage with SHA-256 manifest reconciliation

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Corrupted or Missing Database Volume
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: PostgreSQL container fails health check; connections refused; I/O corruption errors in logs.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: Isolate database container, freeze write traffic via 503 Maintenance page, lock storage volume.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Provision clean volume, restore latest verified backup using backup_manager with SHA-256 verification, replay WAL.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Execute verify_post_restore_integrity to validate all table counts, foreign keys, and tenant boundaries.

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Accidental Table Drop or Malicious Truncate
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: API 500 error spikes; critical tables return 0 rows; AuditLog/SecurityEvent alert triggered.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: Immediately revoke application write credentials, terminate rogue sessions, acquire advisory lock.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Perform point-in-time recovery (PITR) to timestamp immediately preceding truncation.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Verify table row counts and verify tenant isolation consistency across all workspaces.

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Failed Alembic Migration at Deployment
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: Migration runner non-zero exit; advisory lock timeout; schema version mismatch on container startup.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: CD deployment gate halts roll-out, prevents traffic routing to new containers, holds old version.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Analyze non-destructive failure; if unrecoverable, abort rollout and retain current running image.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Inspect alembic_version table, run test_migration_chain, confirm schema backward compatibility.

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Worker Crash During In-Flight Background Job
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: Worker heartbeat expires; job remains in RUNNING state beyond lock timeout.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: Worker pool supervisor replaces dead worker container; dead worker removed from node registry.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Stale job recovery sweeper reclaims expired lock, increments retry count, moves to dead-letter queue if max retries exceeded.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Verify job transitions from RUNNING -> PENDING (retry) or RUNNING -> DEAD_LETTER without task duplication.

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Total Redis Node Loss / Cache Flush
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: Redis connection timeout in API/Worker; cache misses jump to 100%; health probe returns degraded.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: Fallback to database direct reads; bypass cache layer gracefully without application panics.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Restart Redis instance; workers automatically reconnect with exponential backoff; PostgreSQL remains source of truth for jobs.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Verify BackgroundJob queue continues draining from DB and API services serve authenticated requests.

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Document Storage File Loss / Missing Physical Assets
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: verify_post_restore_integrity flags missing physical storage paths or mismatched checksums.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: Mark affected Document records as 'CORRUPT_STORAGE' or 'RECOVERY_PENDING', prevent download 500s.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Sync physical files from replicated object storage bucket / backup volume matching Document SHA-256.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Run document storage reconciliation check until 100% checksum match is achieved.

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Cross-Environment Database Restore Attempt (Staging -> Prod)
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: restore_database_with_guard detects environment mismatch (target_env=prod without force).
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: Fail-closed RestoreSafetyError raised immediately before any schema or table modification.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Halt execution; operator must confirm appropriate target environment or use explicit override.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Assert that database state and tables remain completely untouched.

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Corrupted Backup File Restore Attempt
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: verify_backup_integrity calculates SHA-256 digest differing from manifest.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: Restore rejected with RestoreSafetyError before touching target database.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Reject corrupt artifact, alert on-call engineer, fetch previous verified backup artifact from catalog.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Confirm target database was not modified and error details identify checksum discrepancy.

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Unhealthy Image Deployment / Rollback to Previous Immutable Digest
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: Container health checks fail consecutive probes post-deploy; CD health gate triggers rollback.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: Reverse proxy traffic routing kept on prior healthy task definition / container set.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Deploy prior immutable image digest without running automated destructive database downgrade.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Verify prior container health check passes 200 OK and backward-compatible schema functions seamlessly.

disaster_recovery_scenarios.title: Split-Brain Scheduler Lock Contention
disaster_recovery_scenarios.detection: Multiple scheduler replicas attempt concurrent interval ticks; advisory lock contention logged.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.containment: PostgreSQL advisory locking ensures exactly one leader holds the execution lease.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.recovery: Non-leader replicas stand by; upon leader termination or lease expiration, next replica acquires lock.
disaster_recovery_scenarios.validation: Verify zero duplicate job dispatches during concurrent scheduler execution.
